criteria.passCondition: Does not imply guaranteed venue acceptance/arrival; any immediately necessary qualifier of a stated claim is present locally

criteria.passCondition: Provider voice offers evidenced selection/order help and a relevant next step without commanding/repeated warnings
criteria.reason: 꽃이랑이 상담·안내하는 제공자 시점이며 고객의 감정을 단정하거나 확인 숙제를 나열하지 않는다.
